title: BXIndustry Editor Mapping
description: Schema for src/pages/<vertical>/editor-mapping.json. Drives the in-app edit drawer (enabled via BXI_ENABLE_EDITING=true). Each entry maps a settings.json jsonPath to either a CSS variable (theme entries) or a DOM selector (content entries). This structure is consistent across every vertical, so this schema is intentionally strict - see src/pages/AGENTS.md for details.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file, used for editor validation/autocomplete only. Not read by the app.

themeSectionMap.description: Groups of theme editor entries keyed by page name. 'global' entries apply across the whole vertical; other keys ('home', 'dashboard', or a vertical-specific extra page like 'claims'/'policies' for insurance) apply only to that page. Omit a page key entirely if that page has no editable theme values (e.g. generic has no 'dashboard').

contentSectionMap.description: Groups of content editor entries keyed by page name. 'global' entries apply across the whole vertical; other keys ('home', 'dashboard', or a vertical-specific extra page like 'claims'/'policies' for insurance) apply only to that page. Omit a page key entirely if that page has no editable content (e.g. generic has no 'dashboard').

themeEntry.description: An editable theme value, backed by a CSS custom property.

friendlyName.description: Human-readable label shown in the edit drawer.

jsonPath.description: Dot-path into settings.json, must point into the theme object (e.g. 'theme.primaryColor').

cssVariable.description: CSS custom property name defined in the vertical's branding.hbs (e.g. '--bxi-primary-color').

contentEntry.description: An editable piece of content, backed by a DOM selector.

friendlyName.description: Human-readable label shown in the edit drawer.

jsonPath.description: Dot-path into settings.json, must point into the settings object (e.g. 'settings.home_page.banner.title'). Arrays are not supported by the editor.

elementSelector.description: CSS selector for the DOM element this value should be written into/read from in the browser.
